business_meaning: Unique technical primary key identifying a customer order
Foreign key linking the order to the purchasing customer account in stg_customers
Calendar date when the customer submitted the order
Standardized fulfillment lifecycle status of the order
Digital sales channel through which the order was placed
Destination country code for order delivery
Gross total amount of the order including 20% VAT and shipping fees, before refunds
Unique technical identifier of the payment transaction event
Foreign key referencing the order being paid or refunded in stg_orders
Calendar date when the payment event was processed by the gateway
Payment instrument used by the customer to settle the transaction
Monetary amount of the payment event expressed in EUROS with 2 decimal places (NEVER integer cents)
Three-letter currency code in which the payment was processed
Last four digits of the payment card used (masked reference, non-PII)
Processing status of the payment event from the payment provider
